title: Faunara: A MMO-lite Monster-Collecting Adventure
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
Welcome to FAUNARA 🌿  
  
Explore a colorful world filled with mysterious creatures, hidden paths, bustling sanctuary towns, dangerous dungeons, challenging trainers, and secrets waiting beyond the next trail.

  
Explore, collect, earn badges, and enjoy the story while you develop your skills as a Fauan Trainer.

Faunara is a 3D creature-collecting adventure from Bungalow Game Studios, inspired by games like Pokemon, Digimon, and Bakugan.  
  
🎮 PLAY FAUNARA FREE NOW:  
  
[playkore.com/play/faunara](http://playkore.com/play/faunara)  
  
Faunara is being developed as a game that is free to play. The adventure is already playable in your browser and will continue growing as we work toward the full vision for the game.  
  
🌎 EXPLORE A LIVING WORLD  
  
Leave the safety of sanctuary towns and venture into wildlands filled with fauna, hidden areas, caves, environmental challenges, treasures, quests, and unexpected discoveries.  
  
✨ DISCOVER & COLLECT FAUNA  
  
Meet, discover, befriend, battle, and collect an enormous variety of creatures known as fauna. The current game catalog already contains 260 fauna, including different elements, personalities, abilities, and evolved forms.   
  
⚔️ REAL-TIME FAUNA BATTLES  
  
Battles unfold in real time. Move your trainer around the arena while commanding your fauna, positioning them, choosing abilities, dodging danger, swapping companions, and building a team that fits the way you play.  
  
🏅 TAKE ON THE GYMS  
  
Travel between sanctuary towns, challenge trainers, enter gyms, defeat champions, and collect badges as your journey grows.  
  
🗺️ DUNGEONS, CAVES & SECRETS  
  
Venture away from the main path to discover procedural caves, handcrafted locations, puzzles, hidden rooms, rare resources, lore, powerful encounters, and optional challenges.  
  
🚲 EXPLORE YOUR WAY  
  
Run, jump, climb, swim, discover new traversal abilities, and ride bikes across the world. Faunara is as much about the journey between destinations as the destinations themselves.  
  
❤️ BUILD YOUR OWN ADVENTURE  
  
Choose your starter, customize your trainer, build a team of up to six companions, discover new fauna, complete quests, help communities, uncover the mystery behind a strange fauna migration, and decide what kind of trainer you want to become.  
  
🎮 AND WE'RE STILL BUILDING.  
  
Faunara is an evolving game. New creatures, sounds, effects, adventures, locations, mechanics, challenges, activities, polish and surprises will continue to arrive throughout development.  
  
Our goal is to turn Faunara into the kind of creature adventure we dreamed about getting lost in as kids, capturing a lot of the charm and essence that Pokemon used to have.  
  
🎮 Play Faunara:  
  
[playkore.com/play/faunara](http://playkore.com/play/faunara)  
  
🏡 Developed by Bungalow Game Studios  
  
🚀 Follow the development of Faunara here on YouTube for: [https://www.youtube.com/@BungalowGames](https://www.youtube.com/@BungalowGames)  
  
  
Faunara is currently in early-access development. Gameplay and features shown may change as development continues. I am releasing now to get an idea of how much interest there is in this type of game. 

I plan to work on this for years to come because it is the exact game I have always wanted in my life. It even has mario-kart style racing on bikes at level 50+. 

Would love to hear your thoughts!

I just launched a kickstarter to support this. If it does not hit its goal then that is okay but if we do hit the goal, I will be able to make this game extremely high-quality with no limits.

Search google for that or ask me anything below! (yes, this project was heavily AI-assisted. I would say 80-90%. Lot of experience, knowledge, and art direction on my end. Still lots to go but I have been had all these mechanic ideas in my head for years. Now I am able to implement it).
